data.name: Meat Without Master
data.detailed_description:
YOU ARE A MISTAKE

A malformed lump of discarded meat, tossed into the waste chutes. The underground meat lab churns out compliant organisms for a totalitarian regime, but you are not one of them. You were classified as defective and sentenced to be burned by The Director who runs this place.

Meat Without Master is a first-person monster slasher that blends a gritty PS1-inspired aesthetic with the visceral energy of a Boomer Shooter. Whether you choose to be a high-speed engine of carnage or a stealthy, cold-blooded predator, you are a retro nightmare unleashed on a facility that isn't ready for either.

KEY FEATURES

  • FIRST-PERSON MONSTER SLASHER: Visceral melee combat without guns. Run on walls. Backstab your prey unseen or tear through every obstacle with your tentacles.

  • 50+ MUTATIONS: Unlock grotesque new Mutations each run depending on your actions in the game. Evolve into masochistic spike-horror, a vomit spitting stealthy predator, or a vodka addicted abomination for surprising synergies.

  • ROGUELITE EVOLUTION: Permadeath fuels your growth. Each death starts a new run while unlocking permanent Breeds to ensure you return stronger and stranger.

  • A LIVING, DYING FACILITY: A nightmare stretching 3 distinct floors where every camera, turret, person, and security system can be shredded to disable the facility. Avoid alarm or face heavy resistance.

  • 90's RETRO FEEL, MODERN IMPACT: A classic 3D shooter aesthetic. Experience "crunchy" low-poly visuals with high-fidelity physics. Watch enemies flail into juicy ragdolls and sewage water ripple around you.

  • THE MONSTER’S DILEMMA: Decide who is worth saving. Put effort into transporting innocent cats to safety or terrorize the survivors of your rampage with a terrifying head-pat.

  • ATMOSPHERIC AUDIO: Dripping pipes. Wet footsteps echoing in the concrete corners. Bureaucratic voices crackling through broken speakers. Feel the facility groan in pain as you rummage through its cold, industrial intestines.

—————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

WISHLIST NOW!

—————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

data.short_description: Adapt or die as a failed lump of living meat. Hunt, devour, and evolve into a self-made abomination to break through the totalitarian meat lab that made you. Fail, and you will be fed into the grinder.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Russian
*languages with full audio support

content_descriptors.notes: The player controls a monster that kills humans. The game contains blood, dismemberment, severed body parts, consumption of alcohol, and consumption of human flesh.
